planSummary: Make ASK the mandatory governance bridge between Codex/Superpowers planning and implementation by requiring plan artifacts, ASK ingestion, active slices, validation, and commit provenance.

slices.title: Plan Mode Handoff Runtime
slices.description: Create ask plan-mode handoff so markdown and JSON plan artifacts are attached to an ASK workflow run, validated, ingested, and recorded as durable handoff state.
acceptanceCriteria: ask plan-mode handoff exists
The command accepts title, source markdown path, JSON plan path, task id, run id, and workflow metadata
The runtime records durable handoff state under .ask/runtime
The runtime emits explicit events for handoff creation, validation, and ingestion
The command returns created ASK task ids and next task when ingestion succeeds

slices.title: Implementation Preflight Runtime
slices.description: Add ask implementation preflight to refuse development when a plan handoff is required but no active ASK slice is present.
acceptanceCriteria: ask implementation preflight exists
The preflight detects missing plan handoff state
The preflight detects no active ASK task
The preflight reports exact recovery commands
The preflight supports documented advisory mode for non-Plan-Mode maintenance

slices.title: Pre-Commit Implementation Contract Gate
slices.description: Extend git hook enforcement so implementation commits cannot bypass ASK slice governance.
acceptanceCriteria: The pre-commit adapter invokes implementation preflight or equivalent runtime check
The gate blocks implementation commits with no active slice or no slice close provenance
Documentation explains recovery from the block
Existing hook behavior remains intact

slices.title: Commit Message ASK-Slice Provenance
slices.description: Add commit-message enforcement so governed implementation commits carry explicit ASK slice provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: A commit message hook adapter exists and is wired by ASK hook installation
Slice-close commits include an ASK-Slice footer
Non-governed implementation commits are blocked unless explicitly classified as docs or tooling maintenance
Tests cover valid and invalid commit messages

slices.title: ASK Next Plan Mode Awareness
slices.description: Teach ask next to surface pending plan handoff and active slice guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: ask next reports pending handoff state when validation or ingestion is incomplete
ask next prioritizes the next open generated slice after ingestion
ask next explains ask task start when implementation is attempted before task start

slices.title: Governance Bypass Finding
slices.description: Make governance bypass attempts visible as OHDER/ASK findings instead of silent operator mistakes.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing handoff, missing active slice, and invalid commit provenance create explainable findings
Findings include evidence, severity, remediation, and artifact references
Findings can be listed through existing governance or finding commands

slices.title: Operator Documentation
slices.description: Document the Plan Mode to ASK handoff lifecycle and expected command flow.
acceptanceCriteria: README or operations documentation describes the handoff loop
Examples show markdown plan, JSON plan, ingest, ask next, task start, implementation, validation, and slice close
The docs clarify ASK, Codex, and Superpowers responsibilities

slices.title: End-to-End Governance Contract
slices.description: Add an end-to-end governance contract proving plan artifact handoff, slice start, validation, and commit provenance enforcement.
acceptanceCriteria: The test exercises the operator flow from plan artifact to governed slice start
The test verifies enforcement blocks bypass when active slice or provenance is missing
The test verifies slice-close commits carry ASK provenance
